title: Download history (quarantine events)
whyItMatters: Records which files were downloaded, from which site, with which app and when.
notes: SQLite file; size and date only, never opened.

steps: Quit Safari and every other browser so the record is no longer written.
Delete the file named in the plan if it still exists.
Empty the Trash, then repeat for any other user account that keeps its own copy.
cleanup.risk: The record of which files came from which site is erased; the downloaded files themselves stay where they are.
cleanup.source: Apple Support, Gatekeeper and runtime protection in macOS: https://support.apple.com/guide/security/gatekeeper-and-runtime-protection-sec5599b66df/web
